entries.title: Psalms 71:1
segments: ¶In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.

entries.title: Psalms 71:2
segments: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.

entries.title: Psalms 71:3
segments: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou [art] my rock and my fortress. {Be...: Heb. Be thou to me for a rock of habitation}

words.text: . {Be...: Heb. Be thou to me for a rock of habitation}

entries.title: Psalms 71:4
segments: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

entries.title: Psalms 71:5
segments: For thou [art] my hope, O Lord GOD: [thou art] my trust from my youth.

entries.title: Psalms 71:6
segments: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: my praise [shall be] continually of thee.

words.text: By thee have I been holden up

entries.title: Psalms 71:7
segments: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou [art] my strong refuge.

entries.title: Psalms 71:8
segments: Let my mouth be filled [with] thy praise [and with] thy honour all the day.

entries.title: Psalms 71:9
segments: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.

entries.title: Psalms 71:10
segments: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together, {lay...: Heb. watch, or, observe}

words.text: against me; and they that lay wait

entries.title: Psalms 71:11
segments: Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for [there is] none to deliver [him].

words.text: him; for [there is] none to deliver

entries.title: Psalms 71:12
segments: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.

entries.title: Psalms 71:13
segments: Let them be confounded [and] consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered [with] reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.

entries.title: Psalms 71:14
segments: ¶But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.

entries.title: Psalms 71:15
segments: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness [and] thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers [thereof].

entries.title: Psalms 71:16
segments: I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD: I will make mention of thy righteousness, [even] of thine only.

entries.title: Psalms 71:17
segments: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.

entries.title: Psalms 71:18
segments: Now also when I am old and grayheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto [this] generation, [and] thy power to every one [that] is to come. {when...: Heb. unto old age and gray hairs} {thy strength: Heb. thine arm}

words.text: me not; until I have shewed
to every one [that] is to come
. {when...: Heb. unto old age and gray hairs} {thy strength: Heb. thine arm}

entries.title: Psalms 71:19
segments: Thy righteousness also, O God, [is] very high, who hast done great things: O God, who [is] like unto thee!

entries.title: Psalms 71:20
segments: [Thou], which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 71:21
segments: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.

entries.title: Psalms 71:22
segments: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, [even] thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel. {the psaltery: Heb. the instrument of psaltery}

words.text: . {the psaltery: Heb. the instrument of psaltery}

entries.title: Psalms 71:23
segments: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.

entries.title: Psalms 71:24
segments: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.

words.text: , for they are brought unto shame
